name: Miles Morales

skins.name: Leap of Faith
skins.lore: The Leap of Faith skin references Miles Morales during his iconic leap from the skyscraper in Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse after finally embracing his role as Spider-Man.

skins.name: Storebought
skins.lore: The Storebought skin references the cheap Spider-Man costume Miles buys from Stan's shop before attending the memorial event for Peter Parker.

skins.name: Porky
skins.lore: The Porky skin references Spider-Ham, the cartoon pig version of Spider-Man from the Spider-Verse movies.

skins.name: Gwen
skins.lore: The Gwen skin references Gwen Stacy, also known as Spider-Woman or Spider-Gwen from the Spider-Verse films.

skins.name: Ps5
skins.lore: The Ps5 skin references Miles Morales' appearance and suit from the Marvel's Spider-Man 2 video game on PlayStation 5.

skins.name: Prowler
skins.lore: The Prowler skin references the alternate universe version of Miles Morales seen at the end of Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse, where Miles became the Prowler instead of Spider-Man.

lore: Miles Morales is a Spider-Man from Marvel Comics and the Spider-Verse films. After being bitten by a radioactive spider, he gained powers similar to Peter Parker alongside unique abilities such as bio-electric venom attacks and camouflage, becoming one of the most popular Spider-Man variants.
